mechanism_narrative: A quarterly increase in GDPC1 exceeding 2% YoY signals strengthening aggregate demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 50% of triggered instances despite strong GDPC1 growth.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained FEDFUNDS rate above 4.5% indicates tightening monetary conditions, predicting negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in tightening periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Always-on: a low UNRATE (< 3.5%) signals a strong labor market, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 40% of instances despite low UNRATE.

mechanism_narrative: Interaction-driven: when INDPRO growth exceeds 1.5% YoY and HOUST increases by > 5% MoM, the combined signal predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO YoY growth > 1.5% and HOUST MoM growth > 5%
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC for the joint signal remains below 0.05 over any 1.5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Regime-conditional: in a post-shock recovery regime, a RSAFS increase > $500M signals strengthening demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 55% of triggered instances in post-shock recovery regimes.

mechanism_narrative: Always-on: a high FEDFUNDS rate (> 4%) predicts negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to increased borrowing costs.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 45% of instances despite high FEDFUNDS.

mechanism_narrative: Threshold-triggered: a PAYEMS increase > 200,000 signals strong labor market growth, predicting positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 50% of triggered instances despite strong PAYEMS growth.

mechanism_narrative: Interaction-driven: when CPIAUCSL growth exceeds 2% YoY and INDPRO growth is below 1% YoY, the combined signal predicts negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days due to potential supply chain disruptions.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL YoY growth > 2% and INDPRO YoY growth < 1%
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC for the joint signal remains below 0.04 over any 1.5-year rolling window.
